apps/scaffolding-e2e/workflows/account-f: Cannot pass with the current merobox: it captures `outputs: {revoked_in: revokedIn}` from an `account_revoke` step, but AccountRevokeStep._get_exportable_variables() exports only `keyRotated`, so the placeholder never resolves and both assertions compare the literal string '{{revoked_in}}' against a namespace id. Core does return `revokedIn` on the revoke response, so the gap is merobox-side only. Register this once a merobox release exports it. Landed unregistered with #3435 and had never run.
apps/scaffolding-e2e/workflows/member-re: Docker-bridge partition primitives cannot construct the divergence deterministically: signing after the heal races the TCP-buffer drain, and signing during the partition is blocked by the readiness gate that requires mesh peers. The reconcile path is covered by unit tests on apply_group_op_mutations; registering this needs a more surgical partition primitive (e.g. an iptables-level drop on one peer pair). See the comment beside the matrix entry in e2e-rust-apps.yml.
